about_the_game:
Enjoy the set of 100 beautiful graphics of officers from "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIII" that can be used in the editing feature in "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE".

Additional Graphics:
The graphics of 100 characters, including Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang, from "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIII".

How to Access:
Officers' graphics can be edited via Edit Original Officers or Edit Historical Officers.
They will be displayed under the Special tag, which can be accessed in either of the following ways:
1. Edit, Edit Original Officers, Create Original Officers/Change Original Officers, and then Portrait
2. Edit, Edit Historical Officers, Edit Historical Officers again, and then Portrait.
